verdict.rationale: The evidence shows on-device processing where prompts, audio and images stay on the phone, and hosted execution is opt-in. Those are privacy postures, not user controls over data retention or deletion. No documented retention settings, retention policy for Wally Cloud requests, or deletion mechanism appears in the pack, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
